basis.quantity: ITUK dealer sell-out, CY2023 (network_pn) vs CY2025 (dealer_pn rolled to network)
basis.price: IE40 PR00 list EUR, 2023-12-31 vs 2025-12-31 vintage
basis.note: Both sides measured. No fitted demand curve and no proxy.

caveats: Two periods only. A single difference cannot separate price response from parc, mix, model change, promotion or competitive entry. This is a cross-section of observed outcomes, not an estimated demand curve.
The 2025 quantity file is dealer grain and has been rolled to network; the 2023 file is already network grain. Level differences between the two files are possible.
Cars are not in scope here: this is ITUK CV only.
A part number with rising volume and rising price contributes a positive elasticity, which is why the distribution is not expected to be centred on the truth.
